# Advisories the dependency audit is allowed to pass with. Read by
# scripts/ci/npm_audit.py.
#
# Target: zero. Every line here needs the founder's approval, a reason and a
# review date. An exception covers exactly one advisory: any other high or
# critical advisory still fails the job, in dev dependencies too (the audit
# never runs with --omit=dev).
#
# Format:  <suite> <advisory id> review=<YYYY-MM-DD>  # reason
#   suite = web
#
# An exception ends on its review date (founder, 2026-10-05). The job warns
# on every run for the 7 days before it. From the date itself the advisory
# fails the job again, until the line is removed (a fix exists) or given a
# new date and reason.
# A line whose advisory is no longer reported is announced as stale; delete it.

# braces (stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns). Dev-only: it is
# reached only through the lint chain eslint-config-next ->
# @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces, and
# `npm audit --omit=dev` reports 0. No patched braces exists (every version up
# to the latest, 3.0.3, is affected), and npm's only offered fix downgrades
# eslint-config-next to 14.2.35, which is not taken. Founder, 2026-10-05.
web GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm review=2026-11-05  # dev-only lint chain; no patched braces exists
